{
  "root_cause": "The datepicker component prevents the default action of the Tab keydown event when the calendar is open, preventing focus from moving to the next focusable element (passengers field). This occurs because the vanilla-calendar-pro library (used by the datepicker) adds a keydown listener to the input that calls preventDefault() for Tab, likely to trap focus within the calendar. However, when the calendar opens via focus, focus remains on the input rather than moving into the calendar, causing the Tab prevention to block navigation to the next field.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add a keydown listener in the capture phase on the datepicker input that calls stopImmediatePropagation() for Tab events. This prevents the library's keydown listener (in the bubble phase) from receiving the event, allowing the browser's default Tab behavior (moving focus to the next focusable element) to occur. The listener is added when the datepicker is initialized and removed when disposed to avoid memory leaks.",
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Tab key navigation will now move focus from the departure date field to the passengers field as expected, restoring logical tab order for keyboard users. Screen reader users will experience predictable focus movement when navigating the form with Tab.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "The datepicker's internal Tab handling for focus trapping within the calendar may be disrupted if the calendar ever gains focus (though currently it does not).",
    "If the vanilla-calendar-pro library relies on the prevented Tab behavior for other functionality, those features may be affected.",
    "Adding event listeners increases potential for memory leaks if not properly removed (mitigated by removal in dispose)."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that pressing Tab when focus is on the departure date input moves focus to the passengers input.",
    "Verify that the datepicker still functions correctly for mouse users (clicking opens calendar, date selection works).",
    "Verify that Escape key still closes the calendar when open (regression guard).",
    "Verify that focus trapping within the calendar works if calendar ever gains focus (though current behavior keeps focus on input).",
    "Verify no JavaScript errors are thrown in console related to the new event listener."
  ]
}
